title: Cast the Net on the Right Side

request.style: English, fishermen's work song, a crew of men singing with a lead, accordion, fiddle, bodhrán and foot stomps, steady pulling rhythm, hopeful and warm, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I'm going fishing, Peter said
And we went with him too
All night we fished on Galilee
And not a fish came through
At dawn a man stood on the shore
Have you any fish, my friends
Cast the net on the right side
And you will find some then

[Chorus]
Cast the net on the right side
Haul it in, haul it in
A hundred fifty three great fish
And the net was not torn

[Verse]
It is the Lord, said John to him
And Peter jumped into the sea
A fire of coals upon the beach
With fish and bread for free
Come and have breakfast, Jesus said
And no one dared to ask
They knew it was the Lord himself
Who served them at the last

[Chorus]
Cast the net on the right side
Haul it in, haul it in
A hundred fifty three great fish
And the net was not torn
